examples_opening: These pairs show the contract holding on a real notice, a sparse notice and an addendum that changes a deadline. Example 1 is text captured from a real public web page (see samples/01-real-public-notice/PROVENANCE.md); examples 2 and 3 are synthetic. A fourth, larger real example (a 16-page RFP, with its PDF) is in samples/04-real-tbrpc-auditing-rfp/. Examples are never evidence for a new run.
